# nullplatform_provider_configs (Data Source)

Lists the provider configurations defined exactly at an NRN. Configurations defined at its ancestors or descendants are not listed: an account's NRN lists the account's configurations, its namespaces' NRNs do not. The listing does not include the configurations' attributes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    nullplatform = {
      source = "nullplatform/nullplatform"
    }
  }
}

provider "nullplatform" {}

# The provider configurations defined exactly at an account
data "nullplatform_provider_configs" "account" {
  nrn = "organization=1234567890:account=987654321"
}

output "provider_config_ids" {
  value = [for config in data.nullplatform_provider_configs.account.provider_configs : config.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `nrn` (String) The NRN to list provider configurations at, e.g. `organization=1:account=2`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `provider_configs` (List of Object) The provider configurations defined at the NRN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provider_configs))
